f.title: Apply the Division 5 definition of adverse drug reaction (clinical trials)
f.statement: For Division 5 (drugs for clinical trials involving human subjects), an adverse drug reaction means any noxious and unintended response to a drug that is caused by the administration of any dose of the drug.
f.clause: C.05.001 Interpretation
f.applicability: Drugs for clinical trials involving human subjects (Division 5)
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Reporting policy

f.title: Apply the Division 5 definition of adverse event (clinical trials)
f.statement: For Division 5, an adverse event means any adverse occurrence in the health of a clinical trial subject who is administered a drug, that may or may not be caused by the administration of the drug, and includes an adverse drug reaction.
f.clause: C.05.001 Interpretation
f.applicability: Drugs for clinical trials involving human subjects (Division 5)
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Case processing & follow-up

f.title: Apply the Division 5 seriousness criteria for adverse drug reactions
f.statement: For Division 5, a serious adverse drug reaction means an adverse drug reaction that requires in-patient hospitalization or prolongation of existing hospitalization, that causes congenital malformation, that results in persistent or significant disability or incapacity, that is life threatening or that results in death.
f.clause: C.05.001 Interpretation
f.applicability: Drugs for clinical trials involving human subjects (Division 5)
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Medical review

f.clause: C.05.001 Interpretation
f.applicability: Drugs for clinical trials involving human subjects (Division 5)

f.title: Ensure the clinical trial is conducted under GCP with quality systems and procedures
f.statement: Every sponsor shall ensure that a clinical trial is conducted in accordance with good clinical practices and, without limiting the generality of that, shall ensure that the trial is scientifically sound and clearly described in a protocol, that the trial is conducted and the drug is used in accordance with the protocol and Division 5, and that systems and procedures that assure the quality of every aspect of the clinical trial are implemented.
f.clause: C.05.010 Sponsor's Obligations - Good Clinical Practices
f.applicability: Applies to the sale or importation of drugs for clinical trials involving human subjects (C.05.002(1)).
f.processes: Quality system & CAPA; Clinical safety monitoring

f.title: Ensure subjects are informed of risks before written informed consent
f.statement: The sponsor shall ensure that written informed consent, given in accordance with the applicable laws governing consent, is obtained from every person before that person participates in the clinical trial, but only after that person has been informed of the risks and anticipated benefits to his or her health arising from participation and of all other aspects of the trial necessary for the decision to participate.
f.clause: C.05.010 Sponsor's Obligations - Good Clinical Practices
f.applicability: Applies to the sale or importation of drugs for clinical trials involving human subjects (C.05.002(1)).
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Cross-functional handoffs

f.title: Obtain the qualified investigator undertaking to warn subjects and REB of risks on discontinuance

f.applicability: Applies to the sale or importation of drugs for clinical trials involving human subjects (C.05.002(1)).

f.title: Submit information or samples within 2 days when the Minister has safety grounds
f.statement: The Minister shall require a sponsor to submit, within two days after receipt of the request, information concerning the drug or the clinical trial, or samples of the drug, if the Minister has reasonable grounds to believe that the use of the drug for the purposes of the clinical trial endangers the health of a clinical trial subject or other person (or on the other grounds listed in C.05.013(1)(b) to (e)). The sponsor must submit the requested information or samples within that two-day period.
f.clause: C.05.013 Submission of Information and Samples
f.applicability: Applies to the sale or importation of drugs for clinical trials involving human subjects (C.05.002(1)).
f.exceptions: Other triggering grounds in C.05.013(1)(b)-(e): trial contrary to the best interests of a subject; objectives will not be achieved; a qualified investigator is not respecting the C.05.012(3)(f) undertaking; information submitted is false or misleading.
f.processes: Submission operations; Clinical safety monitoring

f.title: Inform the Minister of trial discontinuance within 15 days, with reasons and impact
f.statement: If a clinical trial is discontinued by the sponsor in its entirety or at a clinical trial site, the sponsor shall inform the Minister no later than 15 days after the date of the discontinuance, and provide the Minister with the reason for the discontinuance and its impact on the proposed or ongoing clinical trials in respect of the drug conducted in Canada by the sponsor.
f.clause: C.05.015 Discontinuance of a Clinical Trial
f.applicability: Clinical trials discontinued by the sponsor in their entirety or at a site
f.processes: Submission operations; Clinical safety monitoring

f.title: Inform all qualified investigators of discontinuance and of potential health risks
f.statement: On discontinuance of a clinical trial in its entirety or at a site, the sponsor shall, as soon as possible, inform all qualified investigators of the discontinuance and of the reasons for it, and advise them in writing of any potential risks to the health of clinical trial subjects or other persons.

f.applicability: Clinical trials discontinued by the sponsor in their entirety or at a site
f.processes: Safety communications; Clinical safety monitoring

f.title: Stop sale or import and recover unused drug at each discontinued site
f.statement: In respect of each discontinued clinical trial site, the sponsor shall stop the sale or importation of the drug as of the date of the discontinuance and take all reasonable measures to ensure the recovery of all unused quantities of the drug that have been sold.
f.clause: C.05.015 Discontinuance of a Clinical Trial
f.applicability: Discontinued clinical trial sites
f.processes: Cross-functional handoffs; Clinical safety monitoring

f.title: Resume a discontinued trial or site only after submitting the required information
f.statement: If the sponsor has discontinued the clinical trial in its entirety or at a site, it may resume selling or importing the drug for the trial if, for each site where sale or importation is to resume, it submits to the Minister the information referred to in subparagraphs C.05.005(c)(ix) and (x) and paragraphs C.05.005(d) and (h).
